# RFP ACT SACT 27-01

Request for Proposal for **Contractor Support for Capability Development Management Support (CDMS)**.

**Bid Closing Date**: The Contracting Officer has extended the closing date for Labor Categories 24 – 27 that were added under Amendments 3 & 4. The bid closing for those labor categories will be **3 November 2026**. All other labor categories will remain due **20 October 2026**.

Bids shall be received at HQ SACT, Purchasing and Contracting Office, **no later than the dates stated above for the different Labor Categories**, 0900 hours, Eastern Standard Time, Norfolk, Virginia, USA. No bids shall be accepted after this date and time. No hard copy proposals will be accepted.

[**Click here to open RFP ACT SACT 27-01 Amendment #4**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/rfp027001_amdt4.pdf)
